_about: GitHub issue #2 (white boxes after loading), part 1 of 2. Puts objects into the city the way builds up to 0.1.1 left decorative decals (runtime copies named 'Placemaker Decal <tier> - <decal>', which only this game has) and saves the city. Part 2 (decal-reload-load.json) loads that save in a fresh game: Send-Suite -Fresh. suite/README.md, 'Save and reload'.
